title: 8.1.1a | Hotfix
body:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/acf63df977d503dc35f78e7ee82ed3475862b978.png[/img]
[i]This update will release as soon as it becomes available on each platform. Players on version 8.1.1a will be unable to matchmake or join parties with players on version 8.1.1.[/i]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a desync between the map tiles generated on the server and what players see
[/list]
